keyEvents.text: Goal! New York Red Bulls 1, San Diego 0. Julian Hall (New York Red Bulls) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jorge Ruvalcaba.
Goal! New York Red Bulls 2, San Diego 0. Devin Padelford (New York Red Bulls) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Cade Cowell with a cross following a corner.

Goal! New York Red Bulls 3, San Diego 0. Jorge Ruvalcaba (New York Red Bulls) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Ronald Donkor with a through ball.
Jeppe Tverskov (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Julián Bazán (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Anders Dreyer (San Diego) left footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Ethan Horvath (New York Red Bulls).
Delay in match because of an injury Ronald Donkor (New York Red Bulls).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (San Diego).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
